name: ravar

relevance.justification: RAVAR is a curated repository of rare variant-trait/disease associations, covering core BioThings entity types (gene, variant) and their relations to phenotypes/traits. Records are structured tabular data (gene symbol, Ensembl ID, RSID, chromosome position, MAF, beta, p-value) with standard identifiers (Ensembl gene IDs, dbSNP rs-numbers, EFO/HPO ontology IDs for traits), directly aligned with MyGene.info / MyVariant.info entity models.

novelty.justification: RAVAR curates literature-derived statistical evidence (p-value, effect size/beta, 95% CI, testing method) linking rare variants and genes to traits/diseases from 245 manually reviewed publications (exome/GWAS rare-variant studies). This is distinct from what MyVariant.info already aggregates (ClinVar pathogenicity calls, gnomAD/ExAC population frequencies, dbNSFP functional predictors) -- RAVAR instead supplies curated rare-variant association evidence (gene-level burden/collapsing-test results and variant-level single-SNP association statistics) mapped to EFO/HPO trait ontology, which is not represented in existing BioThings sources. Some overlap exists with MyDisease.info's DisGeNET gene-disease associations, but RAVAR is rare-variant-specific with full statistical provenance (p-value, method/software, PMID) rather than DisGeNET's broader curated/text-mined gene-disease scores.

openness.justification: Site states 'RAVAR ... is openly accessible without the requirement for user login' and is licensed CC BY 4.0 (Creative Commons Attribution). Four bulk TSV files (publication_allinfo.txt, trait_allinfo.txt, gene_fulltable.txt, snp_fulltable.txt) are directly downloadable via a stable REST endpoint under www.ravar.bio/api/download/static/ with no authentication, API key, or click-through agreement required. Confirmed by direct curl download of all four files.

evidence.scope: Curated rare variant-trait/disease associations at gene level (burden/collapsing test results) and variant level (single-SNP association statistics) from exome and rare-variant GWAS studies, mapped to standardized EFO/HPO trait ontology terms.
evidence.overlap: Partial overlap with MyDisease.info (DisGeNET gene-disease associations) and MyVariant.info (variant annotations), but RAVAR's rare-variant-specific curated statistical association evidence (p-value, beta, MAF, testing method, source publication) is not represented in either.

api_info.record_coverage: full (query/detail access; bulk data covered instead via static download files)

risks: Site is a JS-rendered SPA (Vue app) -- the download page itself returns no useful static HTML; direct file URLs were recovered by inspecting the compiled JS bundle for the underlying REST API base path (/api/download/list).

The API's own file-size metadata for gene_fulltable.txt (listed as '33.1M') is stale relative to the actual downloaded file (~130MB observed), indicating the database has grown substantially since that metadata was last refreshed -- record counts in this report are recomputed from the actual downloaded files, not the paper's or API's stated sizes.

Paper's Data Availability section describes 'Excel files' on the Download page, but the actual API-served files are tab-separated .txt files -- a MISMATCH noted for the inspection report (format is more ingestion-friendly than described, not a blocker).
next_actions: Proceed to plugin generation using the four bulk TSV files
